36430.question_text: If log 2 = x, log 3 = y and log 7 = z, find, in terms of x, y and z, the value of log (\(\frac{28}{3}\))
36430.explanation:
log (\(\frac{28}{3}) = \log (\frac{7 \times 4}{3})\)

= log 7 + log 4 - log 3

log 7 + log \(2^2\) - log 3 = log 7 + 2log2 - log 3

= z + 2x - y

= 2x + z - y

36469.subject: Mathematics
36469.question_text: Each of the interior angles of a regular polygon is 140<sup>o</sup>. Calculate the sum of all the interior angles of the polygon
36469.explanation:
Each interior angle = 140

\(\frac{(n - 2) \times 180}{n} = 140\)

(n - 2) x 180 = 140n

150 - 360 = 140n

180m - 140n = 360

40n - 360

n = \(\frac{360}{40}\)

n = 9

Sum of all interior angles = (n - 2) x 180

= (9 - 2) x 180

= 7 x 180

= 1260

36472.subject: Mathematics
36472.question_text: A box contains black, white and red identical balls. The probability of picking a black ball at random from the box is \(\frac{3}{10}\) and the probability of picking a white ball at random is \(\frac{2}{5}\). If there are 30 balls in the box, how many of them are red?
36472.explanation:
Total no of balls = 30

Let x = no. of red balls

Pr(red) = \(\frac{x}{30}\)

Pr(black) = \(\frac{3}{10} = \frac{9}{30}\)

Pr(white) = \(\frac{2}{5} = \frac{12}{30}\)

No. of black balls = 9

No. of white balls = 12

9 = 12 + x = 30

x = 30 - 21

x = 9

No. of red balls = 9

OR

Let w = no of white balls

     B = no of black balls

     R = no of red balls 

Pr(black balls) = \(\frac{3}{10}\)

Pr(white balls) = \(\frac{2}{5}\)

But Pr(white balls) = \(\frac{2}{5}\) = \(\frac{W}{30}\)

cross multiply 

W = no of white balls = 12

Pr(black balls) = \(\frac{3}{10}\) = \(\frac{B}{30}\)

cross multiply

B = no of black balls = 9

Total number of balls in the basket = W + B + R = 30 ( given)

                                                        = 12 + 9 + R = 30 

                                                       R = 30 - 12 - 9 = 9

Therefore, the no of red balls = 9.

36474.subject: Mathematics
36474.question_text: The angles of triangle are (x + 10)<sup>o</sup>, (2x - 40)<sup>o</sup> and (3x - 90)<sup>o</sup>. Which of the following accurately describes the triangle?
36474.explanation:
(x + 10)o + (2x - 40)o + (3x - 90)o = 180

6x - 120 = 180

6x = 180 + 120

6x = 300

x = \(\frac{300}{6}\)

x = 50

x + 10o = 50o + 10o = 60o

2x - 40 = 2(50o) - 40 = 60o

3x - 90 = 3(50o) - 90o = 60o

Hence, it is an equilateral triangle

options.text: it is right angled isosceles triangle
It is an isosceles triangle but not right angled
